ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Family Psychology - Students will: (a) examine theories and empirical literature on family relationships, (b) articulate how family relationships impact the mental health of individual family members, and (c) articulate the connections between family relationships, mental health, and their socio-cultural context with an emphasis on ethnocultural background, social support systems, and human services. Prerequisites: PSYC 238 is required. PSYC 235 or equivalent is recommended but not required.
